entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a hall of master smiths and scholars. One square, fully enclosed mud-brick hall with a flat roof and a raised central roof block with small windows, round bronze discs set in the front wall, a clay furnace with a short chimney beside the door and one indigo banner.

style.suffix: Smooth sun-dried mud walls with rounded corners and projecting wooden beam ends. Chunky low-poly shapes, hard edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
style.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Walls: sun-dried mud plaster, warm tan-brown clay (#A87A56) with darker streaks (#7E5A40). Beam ends, doors and poles: weathered brown wood (#6E5A44). Thatch and mats: warm straw (#C9A650). Fittings: burnished bronze (#B07A3A). Awnings and banners: plain saturated indigo blue cloth (#2E3F8F), no emblem. Openings: dark (#3A2E28). No text or logos.
